name: Experience & Freebie Costs (Laws of the Night Revised)

text.content:
At character creation your table uses the custom point-buy (Attributes 7/5/3, Abilities 11, Disciplines 5, Backgrounds 5, Virtues 10, Willpower start by Generation) plus 12 Freebie (Free) Traits — up to 7 more from Flaws, and an optional Derangement for +2 (max 21). Spend Free Traits at these costs:

PurchaseFree Trait Cost
Attribute Trait1
Ability Trait1
Specialization1
Background Trait1
Virtue Trait2
Morality Trait3
Willpower Trait3 (subject to generation cap)
Basic Discipline (one Discipline)3
Merit= the Merit's listed value

Gaining Free Traits: each Negative Trait = 1; a Derangement or a removed Morality Trait = 2; Flaws = their individual listed value.

After creation, characters improve by spending Experience Traits (1–3 awarded per session). Costs (Laws of the Night Revised, p. 123–124):

PurchaseExperience Cost
Attribute Trait1
Ability Trait1 (ratings 1–5), 2 (ratings 6–10)
Background Trait1 (with ST approval)
DisciplineBasic 3 / Intermediate 6 / Advanced 9 (+1 if out of clan)
Humanity / Path Trait2 (with ST approval)
Virtue Trait3
Willpower Trait3 (subject to generation cap)
Necromancy / Thaumaturgy RitualBasic 2 / Intermediate 4 / Advanced 6
Specialization1 (in an Ability already known)
New Meritdouble the Merit's listed cost (Narrator approval)
Buy off a Negative Trait2
Buy off a Flawdouble the Flaw's cost (ST approval)

“Out of clan” Disciplines cost +1 Experience per level. Experience is tracked on the sheet and managed by players; nothing is auto-deducted.
